articles.title: M62 Lanes Reopen After Lorry Recovery at Junction 20
articles.excerpt: Lanes 2 and 3 have reopened on the M62 eastbound at Junction 20 following the recovery of a broken down lorry, but delays of up to 30 minutes remain on the approach.
articles.content_html:
Lanes 2 and 3 have reopened on the M62 eastbound at Junction 20, near Rochdale, following the recovery of a broken down lorry in lane 2.

The incident caused significant delays, with traffic reported to be backed up for up to 30 minutes on the approach to the junction.

Motorists are advised to remain cautious as congestion may persist while traffic returns to normal.

The recovery operation was completed earlier today, allowing for the reopening of the affected lanes.

articles.title: Rochdale Woman Passes Driving Test at Local Centre
articles.excerpt: Jade Lomax from Rochdale successfully passed her driving test this morning at the Rochdale Test Centre, marking another achievement for Team Fletch.
articles.content_html:
A woman passed her driving test this morning at the Rochdale Test Centre. Jade Lomax, from Rochdale, achieved this milestone with the support of Team Fletch.

The announcement was made on social media, celebrating her success and encouraging others to pursue their driving goals.

Team Fletch has been known for helping individuals prepare for their driving tests, and this latest success adds to their growing list of achievements.

Those interested in learning to drive can contact Team Fletch through social media or by phone. Jade's accomplishment highlights the ongoing efforts of driving instructors in the area to support learners. This success story may inspire others in Rochdale to take the next step towards obtaining their driving licences.
